scope: Sample authenticity, source identity and assistance semantics
correction: Five branded synthetic examples were removed because they did not establish vendor export compatibility.

supplied_sources.status: Real human tutoring; publisher machine transcription, no original recording independently verified
Assigned conditions, not delivered help events

measurement_companion.unit: 10 distinct exact-span coded intervals from 60 annotation rows, two sessions, one provider
measurement_companion.label_origin: Published LLM-assisted labels over human situation/action/result commentary; no new QLM classifier
measurement_companion.binding: Exact checked transcript excerpt plus matching transformed turns and source provenance
measurement_companion.exclusions: OATutor summaries and unmatched inputs are unmeasured, not zero assistance
measurement_companion.limits: Overlapping descriptive audit intervals; no effectiveness score or validated comparison across products

evidence_boundary: Exact bytes independently checked against fresh downloads of pinned original files.
Source identity to release is not independent verification of underlying research or transcription.
No vendor integration, pooled learning effect, efficacy ranking or unassisted-performance claim.
Tutor turns are not automatically classified as scaffolding or successful help.
Generated enrichments, annotations and simulated replay dialogue are not observed source events.
Entry timestamps are import times; source offsets remain relative.
Subject pseudonyms are scoped to dataset, tenant and key; record units are sessions or participant summaries, not distinct-person counts.
Public data retain CC BY 4.0 attribution; code licensing does not relicense data.

excluded.reason: No authorized redistributable native rows verified; counts are not event timelines.
Authentic publicly redistributable native samples not verified.
Real hint/scaffold summaries verified but explicit redistribution terms not established for bundling.

verification.full_source_retrieval: Fresh public HTTPS downloads matched all four recorded original-file SHA-256 hashes: transcripts, derived labels, raw human annotations and participant CSV.
verification.extraction: Exact documented source JSONL lines and original CSV header/data rows matched sample bytes.
verification.source_licenses: Both primary publishers identify CC BY 4.0.
